items.text: Will Campbell, Drake Maye's left tackle in NE, left the 45-17 win over LV with what is believed to be a knee sprain and is expected to miss time; rookie Caleb Lomu took over. Maye threw for 374 and 4 TDs in the game. He is QB11 rest of season for me. Monitor; Will Campbell's MRI result Monday.

items.watch: the MRI result and Wednesday's Week 6 practice report
items.text: Michael Penix Jr. (ATL) hurt his ribs late in the 30-23 overtime loss to BAL after going 19 of 32 for 240 and a TD, and Tua Tagovailoa played overtime. Penix gets an MRI Monday, per Adam Schefter, and says he expects to be ready for Week 6. Penix is QB23 rest of season for me; leave Tagovailoa, QB37, on waivers. Monitor Penix; the MRI result and Wednesday's practice report.

items.watch: the foot imaging this week and Wednesday's Week 6 practice report
items.text: Quinshon Judkins (CLE) was in a walking boot on his right foot after the 17-12 loss at NYJ, per Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal, after 14 carries for 44 and 3 catches. Dylan Sampson is on IR, so Cleveland has no proven back behind him. Judkins is RB20 rest of season for me; hold him until the imaging is in. Monitor; the foot imaging this week and Wednesday's practice report.

Deebo Samuel Sr. (SF) hurt his right hamstring on an end-around in the third quarter @SEA, fumbled on the play and was ruled out. Ricky Pearsall is out for the season and Jacob Cowing left with an ankle injury. Mike Evans is WR26 rest of season for me and the receiver San Francisco leans on. Samuel is WR39 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

Tre' Harris (LAC) hurt his hamstring in the third quarter vs DEN with 2 catches for 16 and was questionable to return. Quentin Johnston (chest) was inactive and Ladd McConkey (foot) has barely played in two weeks, so the Chargers were down to Marquez Valdes-Scantling and Derius Davis outside. Harris is WR63 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

items.why: A second straight game as a top-two target for Jameis Winston would move him into my top 10 rest of season; a drop back under six targets would not change the hold.
items.text: Isaiah Likely (NYG) caught a career-high 11 passes for 94 yards and 2 TDs in the 27-27 overtime tie with WAS, as Jameis Winston threw 54 times for 326 and 3 TDs. Likely is TE11 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell off one game.

Tyson Bagent (CHI) threw two interceptions in the 31-7 loss at GB and was pulled for Case Keenum in the fourth quarter. Chicago hopes Caleb Williams (hamstring) is back for Week 6. Williams is QB10 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

items.why: A second straight week with Samaje Perine leading the carries and Brown's targets drying up would move him down.
items.text: Chase Brown (CIN) did not lead Cincinnati in carries for the first time this season: Samaje Perine ran 14 times for 68 at MIA, and Brown lost a fumble in the red zone. Brown has 22 carries for 49 yards the last two games, with 10 catches in Week 4. RB6 rest of season for me; hold him.

Roman Wilson (PIT) left the 34-22 win over IND with a finger injury and was ruled out, and Ben Skowronek (calf) went out too. Rookie Germie Bernard caught 6 for 80; he is WR84 rest of season for me, an add only in deep leagues at 0 to 2 percent. Wilson is WR102 rest of season for me; drop him for any add on the list.

KC Concepcion Jr. (CLE) left in the first quarter vs NYJ with a head injury and did not return. Isaiah Bond played a season-high 46 snaps and dropped all three of his targets; leave Bond on waivers. Concepcion is WR41 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.
Kenyon Sadiq (NYJ) was ruled out of the 17-12 win over CLE with a concussion. TE19 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

items.watch: his concussion protocol updates after Minnesota's Week 6 bye
items.text: T.J. Hockenson (MIN) took a concussion on the first drive at NO after a 7-yard catch and did not return, and backup Josh Oliver is already out with a torn biceps. Kevin O'Connell hopes Hockenson clears the protocol over the Week 6 bye. TE21 rest of season for me. Monitor; the protocol updates after the bye.

TreVeyon Henderson (NE) left the 45-17 win over LV with an ankle injury and was ruled out. Rhamondre Stevenson led New England with 64 rushing yards and a 5-yard TD; he is RB24 rest of season for me, so hold him. Henderson is RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

David Montgomery (HOU) left in the second quarter at TEN with a groin injury after 5 carries for 11 and was ruled out at halftime. RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

Woody Marks (HOU) played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN after David Montgomery left, and no other Houston back touched the ball: 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches for 23 on 4 targets. Marks is RB40 rest of season for me with Montgomery healthy, and the lead back while he is out. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

items.why: A route share close to Nico Collins' in his first two Houston games moves him up; a third-receiver role makes him a drop.
items.text: Arizona traded Marvin Harrison Jr. (HOU) to Houston for a 2027 second-round pick and a sixth, per NFL Network and ESPN, and DeMeco Ryans confirmed it after the 26-3 win at TEN. He had 5 catches for 85 and a TD in four Arizona games, and Nico Collins is still Houston's top target. Harrison is WR43 rest of season for me; hold him through his first two Houston games.

Will Shipley (PHI) left Sunday's London game @JAX in the second quarter with a foot injury and did not return, after 5 carries for 6 yards and a touchdown and a 7-yard catch. Saquon Barkley is out and Tank Bigsby is on IR. Shipley is RB56 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.

items.watch: Barkley's Wednesday practice report before Week 6 waivers
items.text: Dameon Pierce (PHI) and Carson Steele finished the London game @JAX as Philadelphia's only healthy backs after Will Shipley's foot injury. Pierce was signed from the practice squad Wednesday. Monitor Pierce; Saquon Barkley's Wednesday practice report decides if he is worth a Week 6 claim.
Ja'Marr Chase (CIN) cleared the concussion protocol and is active at MIA, per Adam Schefter, after leaving Week 4 early. WR11 for me this week, borderline WR1/WR2.
Tee Higgins (CIN) is active at MIA after missing two practices with the groin and neck. In his first game back he is outside my top 50 receivers, a dart throw; sit him.
Jordan Addison (MIN, hamstring) is inactive at NO after a missed Wednesday and two limited days. Pivot to Tre' Harris, WR35 for me in the late window vs DEN, a low-end WR3.
Justin Jefferson (MIN) is active at NO after three limited practices on the ankle, and Jordan Addison is out. WR18 for me this week, a WR2.
Rico Dowdle (PIT, toe) is inactive vs IND. Jaylen Warren played 69 of 71 snaps at CLE without him and is RB7 for me. Pivot to Jaylen Warren.
Ashton Jeanty (LV) is active at NE after no practice Friday with the foot and ankle. RB18 for me this week, an RB2.
Carnell Tate (TEN) is active vs HOU after two limited days with back tightness. He drew 12 targets at BAL. WR24 for me this week, a WR2.
Rhamondre Stevenson (NE) is active vs LV after three limited practices with the knee. He out-snapped TreVeyon Henderson 35 to 25 at BUF. RB24 for me this week, an RB2.
Alvin Kamara (NO) is active vs MIN after two limited days with the back. RB26 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.
Terry McLaurin (WAS) is active vs NYG after sitting in London with the hamstring, with one practice behind him. Outside my top 50 receivers this week, a dart throw; sit him.

items.watch: the trade announcement after Sunday's games
items.text: Arizona is finalizing a trade of Marvin Harrison Jr. (ARI), per ESPN and NFL Network, and he is inactive Sunday vs DET while it closes. Houston is the team named with interest; nothing is announced before Sunday's games. He has 5 catches for 85 in four games. WR43 rest of season for me until the new role is known. Monitor; the trade announcement after Sunday's games.
Michael Wilson (ARI) has drawn 30 targets the last two games, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is inactive Sunday, so more of the outside targets stay with Wilson. WR7 for me vs DET.

DJ Moore (BUF) practiced on a limited basis Saturday after two missed days, is questionable for Monday night @LAR with the AC joint sprain and travels, per Joe Brady. Josh Palmer (shoulder) is out. Moore stays outside my top 50; Khalil Shakir is WR29, a high-end WR3, and Keon Coleman is WR40, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Monitor Moore; Monday's inactives at 6:45 PM ET.

items.why: A slow practice return after the four games would make him a drop; a clean return keeps him on the bench.
items.text: Pittsburgh put Michael Pittman Jr. (PIT, foot) on IR Saturday, out at least four games. DK Metcalf is WR18 for me vs IND, a WR2, and Roman Wilson is WR46, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Hold Pittman in an IR spot at WR52 rest of season; a slow return after four games makes him a drop.

New England put Mack Hollins (NE, calf) on IR Saturday for at least four games, with A.J. Brown already there. Romeo Doubs has 2 TDs since Brown went down and keeps the outside targets. Doubs is WR26 for me vs LV, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.

Washington downgraded Jeremy McNichols (WAS, quad) to out vs NYG, and Jacory Croskey-Merritt practiced in full Friday with no designation after 45 percent of the snaps in London. RB25 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.
Indianapolis downgraded Darius Slayton (IND, knee) to out @PIT, with Alec Pierce on IR and Keenan Allen questionable after a full Friday. Josh Downs keeps the slot. WR21 for me this week, a WR2.

DJ Moore (BUF) watched practice again Friday with the shoulder he aggravated vs NE, his second straight missed day, and Buffalo designates Saturday for Monday night @LAR. Keon Coleman played 46 of 59 snaps vs NE and caught 6 of 7 for 116 and a score after Moore left; Coleman is WR40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Moore is outside my top 50 this week. Monitor Moore; Saturday's injury report.

Mike Evans (SF, ribs) is off San Francisco's final injury report with no designation after a limited Wednesday and a rest day Thursday. He caught 5 of 8 for 76 playing through it vs DEN. WR24 for me @SEA, a WR2.

Dallas Goedert (PHI) has no designation for London after missing Weeks 3 and 4 with the MCL sprain, and Johnny Mundt goes back to blocking. Goedert is TE35 for me this week @JAX, outside my top 12. Hold him at TE15 rest of season; two games back on a full route share would move him up.
items.why: Two games back on a full route share would move him up; a setback in London would move him down.

items.text: Aaron Glenn ruled out Breece Hall (NYJ, quad) for Sunday vs CLE, along with Adonai Mitchell (finger); Mason Taylor is expected back from the thumb. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries @CHI without Hall. RB16 for me this week vs CLE, an RB2.

Carnell Tate (TEN) was limited Thursday with back tightness, and Robert Saleh says the rookie plays Sunday vs HOU. He drew 12 targets, 39 percent of the team's, @BAL. WR23 for me this week vs HOU, a WR2.

items.why: Sean Tucker taking the goal-line work again with Irving under 15 carries once Baker Mayfield is back would change the call.
items.text: Bucky Irving (TB) ran 21 times for 165 and a touchdown and caught a 5-yard score in Thursday's 24-16 win @DAL, with Sean Tucker at 5 carries and Kenneth Gainwell at 4 carries and 4 targets. Tucker still got the fourth-and-goal carry and was stopped. Irving is RB17 rest of season for me. Hold him.

items.watch: Dallas' first Week 6 practice report Wednesday
items.text: CeeDee Lamb (DAL) left Thursday's 24-16 loss to TB late with a bruised quad, on the thigh that had him on the injury report all week, after 2 catches for 9 on 5 targets. NFL Network reports it is not serious, and Dallas has three extra days before Week 6 against GB. Lamb is WR4 rest of season for me. Monitor; Dallas' first Week 6 practice report Wednesday.

Michael Pittman Jr. (PIT) is out multiple weeks with the foot setback, per Mike McCarthy, and misses Week 5 vs IND. He caught 2 of 4 targets on 60 percent of the routes at CLE. DK Metcalf is WR18 for me this week, a WR2, with the outside targets his. Roman Wilson takes Pittman's outside snaps and is WR56 for me, a dart throw until he shows the snaps. Monitor Pittman; an IR move next week.

Colston Loveland (CHI) drew 9 targets vs NYJ, a team high, with Tyson Bagent at quarterback, after 9 targets in Weeks 1 to 3 combined. Bagent starts again @GB. Loveland is TE8 for me this week and TE4 rest of season.

items.watch: Friday's injury report and Sunday's inactives at 8:00 AM ET
items.text: Dallas Goedert (PHI) returned to practice limited Wednesday, his first practice since the MCL sprain that cost him Weeks 3 and 4. If he plays in London, Johnny Mundt goes back to blocking. Goedert is TE15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report and Sunday's inactives at 8:00 AM ET.

items.watch: his snap share vs JAX Sunday
items.text: Philadelphia signed Dameon Pierce (PHI) from the practice squad Wednesday, with Saquon Barkley week to week and Tank Bigsby on IR. Will Shipley played 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR and stays the lead back, RB22 for me this week, an RB2. Pierce is an early-down slice at most; monitor his snap share vs JAX Sunday.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) missed a second straight practice Thursday with the left ankle, and Tyler Huntley ran the first-team offense again. Huntley is QB28 for me @ATL, outside my top 12. Jackson is QB2 rest of season; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Zay Flowers (BAL) was limited for a second day Thursday with the foot. He is WR9 for me this week @ATL, with Huntley likely throwing to him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

items.watch: Friday's practice and his protocol clearance
items.text: Ja'Marr Chase (CIN) was back at practice Thursday in full pads, but he is still in the concussion protocol and needs a full practice to clear it. WR45 for me this week @MIA until he clears. Monitor; Friday's practice and his clearance.

Tee Higgins (CIN) worked on the rehab field again Thursday, a second straight day without practice, with the Week 6 bye next. Dohnte Meyers is WR48 for me, a dart throw, and gains only if Chase sits too. Monitor Higgins; Friday's injury report.
Malik Nabers (NYG) was back at practice Thursday, limited with the knee after sitting Wednesday. WR10 for me this week @WAS.
Cam Skattebo (NYG) was limited again Thursday with the shoulder but shed the red non-contact jersey. RB19 for me this week @WAS, an RB2.

Terry McLaurin (WAS) missed Thursday's practice with the hamstring, his second straight day out, after sitting in London. Reports on Stefon Diggs conflict, so he stays WR23 for me, a WR2, if he plays. McLaurin is WR29 rest of season. Monitor McLaurin; Friday's injury report.

Kyle Monangai (CHI) missed a second straight practice Thursday. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports turf toe that could cost him one to two weeks; Ben Johnson calls it soreness from the 30-carry game. He is RB18 for me @GB if he plays, an RB2. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

D'Andre Swift (CHI) returned as a limited participant Thursday with the hip and knee, and Roschon Johnson is the only other back behind him if Monangai sits. RB13 for me @GB, borderline RB1/RB2 this week, and higher if Monangai is out.
Alvin Kamara (NO) went from no practice Wednesday to limited Thursday with the back, with Travis Etienne on IR. RB25 for me vs MIN, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Chris Olave (NO) was limited Thursday, and New Orleans added a foot injury to Wednesday's rest day. Tyler Shough practiced in full with the left hand and is QB12 for me, a borderline start. Olave is WR7 for me vs MIN. Monitor Olave; Friday's injury report.

Justin Jefferson (MIN) was limited for a second day Thursday with the ankle, and Jordan Addison joined him as limited. Addison is WR25 for me @NO, a high-end WR3, and his share shrinks if Jefferson plays. Jefferson is WR6 rest of season. Monitor Jefferson; Friday's injury report.

Ashton Jeanty (LV) went from full Wednesday to limited Thursday, with a foot injury added to the ankle. He is RB11 for me @NE, borderline RB1/RB2, and Mike Washington Jr. is next at RB37. Monitor Jeanty; Friday's injury report.
